Research services

Since 2021, I have worked with journalists, historians, and subject matter experts on numerous research projects, including books, podcasts, and long-form journalism.

I am actively looking for new research projects. Typically, I join a project at the outset and remain with the creator through its completion, though I am open to alternative arrangements. Below is a selection of the services I offer and some of the projects I have worked on.

References are available upon request.
